sources.entry: Fileside - A modern, tiling file manager with unlimited panes.

summary.name: Fileside
summary.one_liner: Fileside is a multi-pane file manager for Mac and Windows that lets you save workspaces of panes for different projects.
use_cases: Organizing files separately for each client or project
Moving files between folders side by side in two panes
Replacing Finder on macOS with a multi-pane view
Replacing Explorer on Windows with a dual-pane layout
Reopening a saved set of folders with one click
summary.what_it_does: Fileside is a multi-pane file manager that lets users arrange several panes and save combinations of them as workspaces. Each workspace can be reopened with one click, which suits switching between clients or projects. Users can drag files between panes within a workspace. The app shows the real filesystem rather than hiding it, according to user testimonials on the page. The page describes one license covering both Mac and Windows, and mentions search and pane switching.
notable: Saved workspaces combining multiple panes, reopened with one click
Unlimited panes, described as a tiling file manager
Positioned as an alternative to Finder and Explorer, and to NC/TC-style dual-pane managers
One license covers both Mac and Windows, per user comments
caveats: Pricing details are not stated on the page
Most of the page is user testimonials, so features are only lightly described
